Iris (partnerships): quick ask from the SI team — they want a short telemetry smoke (traces + metrics) on our appliance so the marketplace tile shows healthy charts. Can we do a 30-45m slot next Thu?
Tariq (eng-runtime): yes we can. Need the partner container image, ingest-only key, and the trimmed dashboard json. Also confirm desired sampling policy.
Hugo (datadog-partner): sending dashboard + OTLP collector config by EOD. Sampling: keep 1/5 normal, 1/1 for errors. Will also include a dashboard tile that surfaces exporter_queue_len + cache_evictions.
Nia (eng-ml): to exercise cache evictions we should mix seq lengths [32,256,1024] and hit a few long-response paths. Partner will host model runtime.
Ruth (product): success criteria: tiles render within 30s of start, alerts evaluate correctly, and exporter memory growth <20% over 30m. Legal needs 24h review for any quote.
Tariq (eng-runtime): plan: 1) staging smoke (15m) 2) tune exporter flags (batch_size, linger_ms) 3) partner run 4) capture dashboard snapshots + perf strip. Who owns snapshots?
Iris (partnerships): partnerships owns press-ready snapshot and partner quote. Eng supplies perf numbers + a 1-line blurb for the tile docs.
Hugo (datadog-partner): will embargo creds and send a wiring blurb for customers.
Tariq (eng-runtime): quick local sanity check command for staging once image is up:
```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST http://localhost:4318/v1/traces -H 'Content-Type: application/x-protobuf' --data-binary @tiny_trace.pbf
# expect 200 and an "accepted" log line from exporter
```
ci-bot: build redwood/embedded-exporter:v1.5.3 passed all checks — deploy when ready (logs: /ci/3471234567).
Nia (eng-ml): test knobs: REDWOOD_MAX_SEQ=1024 REDWOOD_CACHE_TTL=45s and run mixed batch sizes to surface eviction metrics.
Iris (partnerships): actions: Hugo to drop dashboard+collector config by EOD; Tariq/Nia to run staging smoke Fri AM; partner run Thu next week. I'll loop in legal and comms. :rocket:
